# Keyboard shortcuts

Every key Cellucid answers, as the in-app **Keyboard shortcuts** panel lists them (press {kbd}`?`).
The panel, the keys and this page come from one table, so none of them can list a key the others do not.

A key is the page's unless what has focus uses it itself: a text field types it, a dropdown jumps to
the option a typed letter starts, and a menu, a list or a dialog keeps the keys pressed in it. After
a slider, a checkbox or a button the keys work at once (a slider keeps only its arrows, Home, End and
Page keys; a checkbox Space; a button Enter and Space). A shortcut held down acts once; a camera key
moves the camera for as long as it is held. On a Mac, {kbd}`⌘` stands for {kbd}`Ctrl`.

## General

Anywhere on the page, unless focus is in a text field, a list or a dialog (which keep the keys typed in them).

| Keys | What it does |
|---|---|
| {kbd}`R` | Reset camera |
| {kbd}`F` | Fullscreen |
| {kbd}`H` | Toggle sidebar |
| {kbd}`1` {kbd}`2` {kbd}`3` | Embedding · again: next. 1D, 2D or 3D: that dimension's default embedding in the selected view; press again for its next embedding. |
| {kbd}`O` {kbd}`P` {kbd}`G` | Navigation mode |
| {kbd}`?` | Show shortcuts |
| {kbd}`/` | Open the chat |
| {kbd}`Ctrl+Z` | Undo the last step |
| {kbd}`Shift+Ctrl+Z` / {kbd}`Ctrl+Y` | Redo. Ctrl+Y redoes too, except on a Mac; on a Mac, ⌘ stands for Ctrl. |

## Navigation

The camera of the focused view (linked views follow it). Held keys move it for as long as they are held.

| Keys | What it does | Modes |
|---|---|---|
| {kbd}`W` {kbd}`A` {kbd}`S` {kbd}`D` | Orbit / pan / move | Orbit, Planar, Free-fly |
| {kbd}`Shift` | Move faster | Orbit, Planar, Free-fly |

## Zoom

The camera of the focused view.

| Keys | What it does | Modes |
|---|---|---|
| {kbd}`=` {kbd}`]` | Zoom in | Orbit, Planar |
| {kbd}`-` {kbd}`[` | Zoom out | Orbit, Planar |

## Free-fly

The camera in Free-fly.

| Keys | What it does | Modes |
|---|---|---|
| {kbd}`E` {kbd}`Q` | Up / down | Free-fly |
| {kbd}`Esc` | Release pointer | Free-fly |

## Selection

On the plot, with a selection tool chosen.

| Keys | What it does |
|---|---|
| {kbd}`Alt`+click | Highlight group |
| {kbd}`Alt`+drag | Drag with the active tool |
| {kbd}`Shift+Alt`+click | Add to selection |
| {kbd}`Ctrl+Alt`+click | Subtract. Subtract from the selection. |
| {kbd}`Esc` | Cancel selection |
| {kbd}`Esc` | Leave Select mode |
| {kbd}`X` | Clear highlights |

## History list

A focused row of the History list (State panel); the History (i) lists them too.

| Keys | What it does |
|---|---|
| {kbd}`↑` {kbd}`↓` | Next or previous row. With Shift, select several. |
| {kbd}`Home` {kbd}`End` | First or last row. With Shift, select them. |
| {kbd}`PgUp` {kbd}`PgDn` | A page up or down. With Shift, select them. |
| {kbd}`→` {kbd}`←` | Open or close a row. A branch, a turn, a group or a run. |
| {kbd}`Enter` | Show the step. Or double-click the row. |
| {kbd}`Space` | Open its details. Or its ›. |
| {kbd}`Alt+↑` / {kbd}`Alt+↓` | Before or after. Show the step before or after, without its details. |
| {kbd}`F2` | Rename |
| {kbd}`Delete` {kbd}`Backspace` | Delete (asks first) |
| {kbd}`Shift+F10` / {kbd}`Menu` | The row’s menu |
| {kbd}`[` {kbd}`]` | The previous or next fork |
| {kbd}`Ctrl+G` | Group the steps selected |
| {kbd}`Ctrl+Shift+B` | Branch from here. Branch from the step selected. |
| {kbd}`/` | Search the history |
| {kbd}`Esc` | Close the details. With no details open, keep only this row selected. |
| {kbd}`Esc` | Stop a tour of the history |

## Moving by keys

One way to move a thing to a place by keys, wherever it can be dragged: a panel floated or docked, a highlight page into Create categorical and its order, a legend category onto another to merge them. Each place is announced as it is chosen.

| Keys | What it does |
|---|---|
| {kbd}`Enter` {kbd}`Space` | Pick up, then drop |
| {kbd}`↑` {kbd}`←` {kbd}`↓` {kbd}`→` | Choose where it goes. Each place is announced. |
| {kbd}`Home` {kbd}`End` | First or last place |
| {kbd}`Esc` | Cancel |
